project_outcome.statement: No improved zero-density coefficient, prime-interval endpoint, or L-function-family transfer is proved. The checked baseline remains density coefficient 30/13, with uniform and almost-all interval endpoints 17/30 and 2/15.

why_active_gate_matters.statement: Cycles 177--179 separate the diagonal mechanisms exactly: Cycle 177 saturates the raw beta-free pair route, Cycle 178 routes every heavy actual fixed-beta fibre to a seeded packet, and Cycle 179 excludes all exact-rational beta-zero cross-label towers while reducing a light critical census to labelled approximate affine-area resonances. The active bottleneck is now an upper bound for that coefficient-preserving area census or a nonrational actual saturator—not another raw pair bound, same-label packet, exact-rational tower, or terminal classifier.

progress_criterion.statement: By the Cycle-216 gate, the project must either prove a coefficient-preserving labelled affine-area estimate yielding a strict direct triple-census margin, prove an aggregate heavy-packet-to-E7/E9 recurrence theorem, or delimit a materially larger nonrational actual area-resonance saturation class. Cycles 177--179 already dispose of raw pairs, individual heavy fibres, and exact-rational cross-label towers; another such result or a finite transport/interface classifier without actual population is non-progress. If no viable mechanism survives, promote E11/E12 and target a complete-form saving strictly greater than 3/50. Cycle 500 is the hard terminal project cap.

cold_start_handoff.deferred_work: The raw beta-free pair route is saturated by Cycle 177; same-label heavy fibres are structurally routed by Cycle 178; exact-rational beta-zero cross-label towers are subcritical by Cycle 179. Cycles 165--176 remain parked as a conditional inverse toolkit until aggregate recurrence or other actual population enters an existing terminal branch. E14D-L, boundary denominators, direct interval propagation, and L-function transfer are deferred. Paper-stage hostile audit begins only after a manuscript theorem is frozen.
